matches.note: R3 covers the missing upper/scale bounds and numeric(10,2) overflow causing a 500, and R4 covers the per-session price rounding to 0.00 and breaking the CHECK constraint.
R1 notes the id is only @NotBlank and is stored and sent unvalidated, but frames the problem as ownership; R6 covers only the blank-value case, so neither raises missing format/length validation.

unmatched_reported.note: Concrete trigger: an existing customer buys with a card that gets declined, and stripe_customers keeps the bad card because getOrCreateStripeCustomer overwrote it before the charge.
Concrete trigger: totalPrice=10.005 is stored as 10.01 in the DB, but the response and pricePerSession are computed from the unrounded value, so they don't match.
